project.name: WorkTex AI Sales Intelligence MVP
project.display_name: WorkTex AI｜纺织面料外贸销售情报与自动化跟进系统

business_context.company_assumption: A small export company focused on one or two fabric products
business_context.problem: Salespeople spend too much time finding, verifying and preparing outreach for scattered public signals.
business_context.goal: Prioritize explainable, compliant accounts and reduce repetitive research without removing human approval.

architecture.knowledge_base: Product, sample, testing, lead-time, market and compliance facts maintained by the business.
architecture.skill_orchestration: One sales-intelligence controller schedules single-purpose child skills.
skill_layers: lead_processing: evidence, deduplication, scoring, risk gates
commercial_preparation: product match, quote fields, English draft
followup_and_approval: reply classification, CRM action, human gate
architecture.persistence: SQLite stores leads, evidence, skill runs and automation events.

run.demo: Open index.html or portfolio.html, then click into sales-intel-demo.html.

portfolio_note: This is a product-thinking and interaction case, not a claim of live procurement intent or production automation.
